adc.summary: add with carry: dst += src + CF, to chain adds past 16 bits
adc.example:
add ax, bx
adc dx, cx

and.summary: bitwise and: dst &= src; clears CF and OF

call.summary: push the address of the next instruction, then jump

cld.summary: clear the direction flag: string instructions step up

cmp.summary: compare: set the flags from dst - src; dst keeps its value
cmp.example:
scan: add si, 8
cmp word [si], 0
jz scan

cmpsb.summary: compare the byte at si with the byte at di; step si and di

cmpsw.summary: compare the word at si with the word at di; step si and di

dat.summary: kills the process that runs it: opcode 00, what empty core holds

div.summary: unsigned divide ax (word: dx:ax) by src; a 0 divisor or an overflow kills

hlt.summary: kill the process that runs it

idiv.summary: signed divide ax (word: dx:ax) by src; a 0 divisor or an overflow kills

imul.summary: signed multiply: ax = al * src (word: dx:ax = ax * src)

int3.summary: kill the process that runs it; debugger breakpoints never write it

ja.summary: jump if above, unsigned: CF=0 and ZF=0
ja.example:
top: sub cx, 2
cmp cx, 8
ja top

jc.summary: jump if carry, or below unsigned: CF=1

jcxz.summary: jump if cx is 0: guards a loop that would run 65,536 times
jcxz.example:
jcxz done
copy: movsw
loop copy
done: ret

jg.summary: jump if greater, signed: ZF=0 and SF=OF
jg.example:
top: dec ax
cmp ax, 10
jg top

jl.example:
top: inc ax
cmp ax, bx
jl top

jmp.summary: jump to a label, or to the address in a register or memory

jna.summary: jump if not above, unsigned: CF=1 or ZF=1
jna.example:
top: add di, 2
cmp di, si
jna top

jnc.summary: jump if no carry, or above or equal unsigned: CF=0

jng.summary: jump if not greater, signed: ZF=1 or SF≠OF
jng.example:
top: inc ax
cmp ax, 10
jng top

jnl.summary: jump if not less, signed: SF=OF
jnl.example:
top: dec ax
cmp ax, bx
jnl top

jns.summary: jump if not sign, 0 or positive: SF=0

jnz.summary: jump if not zero, or not equal: ZF=0

jo.example:
add ax, bx
jo clip
clip: mov ax, 0x7FFF

jpe.summary: jump if parity even, an even count of 1 bits in the low byte: PF=1
jpe.example:
test al, al
jpe even
even: nop

jpo.summary: jump if parity odd, an odd count of 1 bits in the low byte: PF=0
jpo.example:
test al, al
jpo odd
odd: nop

jz.summary: jump if zero, or equal: ZF=1
jz.example:
scan: add si, 8
cmp word [si], 0
jz scan

lahf.summary: copy SF ZF AF PF CF into ah

lea.summary: load the address of a memory operand, not the value there

lodsb.summary: load the byte at si into al; step si

lodsw.summary: load the word at si into ax; step si

loop.summary: cx -= 1, then jump if cx is not 0

loope.summary: cx -= 1, then jump if cx is not 0 and ZF=1

loopne.summary: cx -= 1, then jump if cx is not 0 and ZF=0

mov.summary: copy a byte or word: dst = src

movsb.summary: copy the byte at si to di; step si and di

movsw.summary: copy the word at si to di; step si and di

mul.summary: unsigned multiply: ax = al * src (word: dx:ax = ax * src)

or.summary: bitwise or: dst |= src; clears CF and OF
or.example:
or ax, ax
jz empty
empty: nop

pop.summary: load the word at sp into dst, then sp += 2

popf.summary: pop a word into FLAGS: OF DF SF ZF AF PF CF

push.summary: sp -= 2, then store the word at sp

ret.summary: pop an address and jump to it; ret n then drops n more bytes

rol.summary: rotate left: the top bit goes to bit 0 and CF

ror.summary: rotate right: bit 0 goes to the top bit and CF

sahf.summary: copy ah into SF ZF AF PF CF

sar.summary: shift right, copies of the sign bit in: a signed halve

sbb.summary: subtract with borrow: dst -= src + CF, to chain subtracts past 16 bits
sbb.example:
sub ax, bx
sbb dx, cx

scasb.summary: compare al with the byte at di; step di

scasw.summary: compare ax with the word at di; step di

shl.summary: shift left, zeros in: an unsigned double

shr.summary: shift right, zeros in: an unsigned halve

spl.summary: start a new process at the target; this one goes on to the next line
spl.example:
spl bomber
guard: jmp guard
bomber: mov word [di], 0

std.summary: set the direction flag: string instructions step down

stosb.summary: store al at di; step di

stosw.summary: store ax at di; step di

test.summary: and without storing: set the flags from dst & src

xor.summary: bitwise xor: dst ^= src; clears CF and OF

rep.summary: repeat a string instruction while cx is not 0, cx -= 1 each time, one a cycle

repe.summary: repeat cmps or scas while cx is not 0 and ZF=1 (equal), one a cycle

repne.summary: repeat cmps or scas while cx is not 0 and ZF=0 (not equal), one a cycle
